summary: End-to-end frontend testing of Interview Practice flow (Phase 3). All three pages (Start, Interview, Complete) render and wire up correctly. Full happy path validated with 10 seeded master_interview_questions: Start -> Begin -> 10x (typing dots -> question -> textarea -> submit gated @50chars -> Evaluating... -> feedback card with score pills + strengths + improvements + model-answer collapsible -> Next) -> Complete page with 3 score rings + overall + 10-item recap -> Continue to Simulation / Practice Again CTAs. markPhaseComplete persisted correctly to Supabase: user_sessions.interview_completed=true AND interview_score=4 (rounded from overall 3.7). Forward-only confirmed (no back button on interview page). Previous exchanges render collapsed above current Q with toggle. Tips card open by default and toggles. Breadcrumb renders module + session + Interview. Zero console errors during core flow. One benign React Router warning when clicking Continue to Simulation -> /simulation route is not yet implemented (expected, Phase 4 not built per product plan).

issues: Breadcrumb renders module label with doubled prefix 'Module 1: Module 1: Foundations of Finance...' because module.title in DB already contains 'Module 1:' and the component additionally prepends 'Module {order_index+1}: '. Cosmetic — same pattern likely exists on sibling Quiz/Notes start pages.

action_items: Cosmetic: Fix doubled 'Module N:' prefix in InterviewStartPage breadcrumb (strip leading 'Module X:' from module.title OR drop the component-prepended 'Module N:'). Same fix likely needed on NotesPage/QuizStartPage breadcrumbs for consistency.

Phase 4 route /session/:sessionId/simulation is not defined in App.js — 'Continue to Simulation' CTA triggers React Router 'No routes matched' warning. Expected if Simulation is a later milestone; otherwise wire up the route.
critical_code_review_comments: InterviewCompletePage save effect uses a state flag (saved) rather than a useRef lock — same potential double-fire risk flagged in iteration 10 for QuizCompletePage. Low risk (PATCH is idempotent, score deterministic given identical results array), but worth tightening.

InterviewPage loops through questions using `key={`q-${idx}`}` for the current-question wrapper but relies on the phase effect keyed on `q` (object identity). If questions were ever refetched in-place (same idx, new object), it would re-run — harmless today but fragile.

interviewEval.js keyPoints 'covered' check uses any-word substring matching (`words.some(w => text.includes(w))`). This can over-credit coverage (e.g., the word 'rate' appearing anywhere marks a full key_point as covered). Consider requiring at least 2 overlapping words or a minimum match ratio.
No network-failure UX on markPhaseComplete in InterviewCompletePage — it only console.errors. Consistent with other complete pages but user has no visual indication score didn't save.
seed_data_creation: No new seeding needed — 10 master_interview_questions rows already exist for master_session_id 10ead237-b2fe-4535-8a21-8eec2536cd72 (seeded by a prior iteration). user_sessions row 5e0c2a88-d864-4827-9a95-5aedd8d27ffd was written to (interview_completed=true, interview_score=4) during test then RESET back to interview_completed=false, interview_score=null for next run. quiz_completed/quiz_score remain false/null; notes_completed=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Row user_sessions.id=ai-career-hub-21 reset to notes_completed=true, everything else false/null. Interview flow is validated end-to-end including Supabase persistence. If main agent adds Simulation (Phase 4) route, re-run this iteration's script — the only change needed is expecting the Continue to Simulation click to land on a real route instead of the current 'No routes matched' warning. Evaluator behavior on sample long answer (4 sentences, ~460 chars): technical=3, communication=4, structure=4, overall=4 per question; aggregated overall 3.7 -> stored interview_score=4.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the Interview flow itself. The only functional gap is the downstream /session/:id/simulation route which is presumably the next milestone.
